extensions.title: GitHub Identity & Supply Chain Risk
selected_searches: GitHub: Repos Vulnerable to Workflow Secret Exfiltration
GitHub: Branch Protection - No Code Owner Reviews
GitHub: Members Can Change Repository Visibility
GitHub: Secret Scanning Push Protection Disabled
extensions.executive_summary: GitHub relationships may expose source code, workflows, secrets, or organization controls to identity-based abuse.
extensions.business_impact: GitHub access can affect source code, software delivery workflows, deployment credentials, and production-facing automation.
extensions.why_this_matters: Developer-platform privileges can become control-plane identity paths when they influence code, workflows, secrets, or deployments.
extensions.technical_summary: Curated GitHub saved searches assess secret reachability, workflow risk, branch protections, repository governance, and organization-wide Actions policy.
extensions.insight: GitHub becomes an identity control point when repository access, workflows, secrets, or organization administration can influence production systems.
immediate_actions: Review secret reachability and organization-wide Actions policy.
Prioritize branch protection and repository visibility weaknesses.
near_term_actions: Standardize repository governance and workflow permissions.
Require effective branch protection and code-owner review where appropriate.
strategic_actions: Include GitHub relationships in recurring identity attack-path reviews.

extensions.title: Okta Workforce Identity Risk
selected_searches: Okta: Read Client Secrets of Privileged Applications
Okta: Unrotated Active Access Keys on Privileged Apps
Okta: Synced Principals with Privileged Access (Direct) - Hybrid Edges
Okta: Synced Principals with Privileged Access (Indirect) - Hybrid Edges
Okta: Principals with Admin Console Access
extensions.executive_summary: Okta administrative, credential, MFA, and hybrid-identity relationships may expose workforce identity and application access.
extensions.business_impact: Okta controls workforce authentication, SaaS assignments, administrative roles, and application access across the enterprise.
extensions.why_this_matters: Compromise of privileged Okta principals or credentials can provide broad access to identities, applications, and authentication controls.
extensions.technical_summary: Curated Okta saved searches assess client secrets, stale keys, password and factor administration, MFA gaps, hybrid privileged access, and console access.
extensions.insight: Okta is a workforce identity control plane; administrative and credential paths can have tenant-wide impact.
immediate_actions: Require strong MFA for privileged identities.
Rotate stale keys and restrict access to privileged application secrets.
Review principals with password, factor, and console administration.
near_term_actions: Review synced and hybrid principals with privileged access.
strategic_actions: Include Okta in recurring identity governance and attack-path reviews.

extensions.title: Jamf Device Administration Risk
selected_searches: Jamf: Account to Account Attack Paths
extensions.executive_summary: Jamf account, tenant, and managed-device relationships may create administrative paths across the endpoint estate.
extensions.business_impact: Jamf can control managed endpoints, software deployment, configuration, and devices used by privileged personnel.
extensions.why_this_matters: Device-management privileges can become identity paths to sensitive endpoints and can expand the blast radius of an account compromise.
extensions.technical_summary: Curated Jamf saved searches assess account-to-account paths, account-to-tenant control, broader account paths, and managed-device scope.
extensions.insight: Jamf is an endpoint administration control plane; account and tenant relationships can affect a broad managed-device population.
immediate_actions: Review account-to-tenant control and high-impact account paths.
Validate administrative access to sensitive managed endpoints.
near_term_actions: Reduce standing Jamf privileges and review service/API accounts.
Validate ownership and management scope for privileged workstations.
strategic_actions: Include device-management administration in recurring identity risk reviews.
